trigger: Hairline cracks noticed / before wet season
steps: Clean the crack of debris and loose material with a wire brush.
For hairline cracks, inject masonry crack sealant/epoxy along the length.
For cracks wider than 1/4 inch or that are growing, have a foundation specialist assess it.
Grade soil away from the foundation to reduce future water pressure on the crack.
Monitor the crack over a season to confirm the repair is holding.
